theme_central: From the complaint of a woman (Khawla) heard by Allah Himself, to the definition of the "allies of Allah" versus the "allies of Satan" — the word "Allah" appears in each of the 22 verses.
sources_note: 3-section structure precisely sourced (Wikipedia Al-Mujadila): 1-6 (zihar), 7-13 (secret conferences), 14-21 (believers vs disbelievers).

branches.title: Zihar
branches.resume: Khawla's complaint heard by Allah; zihar declared unlawful as a method of divorce, expiation prescribed.

children.t: Khawla's complaint, zihar declared unlawful as a method of divorce
Expiation: freeing a slave, fasting two months, or feeding sixty poor people

branches.title: Secret conferences, courtesy
branches.resume: Allah witness to every secret conference; warning against conferences of iniquity; courtesy in assemblies.

children.t: Allah witness to every secret conference, warning against iniquity
Courtesy in assemblies, making room for others

branches.title: Allies of Allah, allies of Satan
branches.resume: The allies of Satan forget Allah's reminder; the allies of Allah will triumph, even against their own relatives.

children.t: The allies of Satan forget Allah's reminder, their fate at the Judgment
The allies of Allah will triumph, not taking as friends those who oppose Allah
